items.title: Role of Hypothesis Testing in Data Analysis

source_refs.note: 'Role of Hypothesis Testing in Data Analysis' under topic 7.1, as printed (PDF 94, printed 90).

blocks.text: Hypothesis testing helps analyze data logically to check whether results are meaningful. Testing avoids random conclusions. It compares results with expectations. Hypothesis testing supports accuracy, which is used in experiments and surveys. Decisions are based on evidence. This method improves confidence in results.
